$comment: Reviewed corrections to defects in the source catalogue.
Each entry removes a single published value that has been checked against
the PDF and found to be wrong. Values are QUARANTINED, never replaced: a
plausible substitute would be this pipeline inventing manufacturer data,
and an invented ampacity is indistinguishable from a real one once it is
in the dataset. With the cell absent the engine simply has no rating for
that cable in that condition and will not select it, which fails safe.
Every entry is echoed into provenance.json so the calculation report can
state which published values were rejected and why.
To resolve one, obtain the correct figure from the manufacturer and add it
as a 'replace' entry citing the source of the confirmed value.

quarantine.reason: Reads 9 A for 10 mm2 between 48 A at 6 mm2 and 85 A at 16 mm2. A dropped digit; the value is roughly an order of magnitude low.
Reads 468 A for 25 mm2 where the same row's trefoil column reads 160 A and 35 mm2 reads 203 A. Roughly 2.3x too high, so accepting it would undersize a cable.
Reads 234 A for 70 mm2 between 235 A at 50 mm2 and 292 A at 95 mm2, so the rating does not rise with conductor size.
Reads 500 A for 70 mm2 between 241 A at 50 mm2 and 364 A at 95 mm2. Roughly 1.7x too high, so accepting it would undersize a cable.
Reads 720 A for 630 mm2 between 733 A at 500 mm2 and 929 A at 800 mm2, so the rating does not rise with conductor size.
